name: A19 one-formula candidate T45 (MOGF0IESM): T44 with the gate threshold M_t set outside the benchmark, on the seven red-central bins of Mandelbaum et al. (2016), so that only the disk rule's A, B, C are fitted to the benchmark
frozen_at: 2026-11-07 10:42 PST, session SA73, after T45 (held out, PROTOCOL_T45 sha256 193809a2...); T44 (e4daaf28...), T43 and T37 stay frozen
halo_formula: M_ref = Mp/fb + 10^A (M*/1e10 Msun)^B (Re/3 kpc)^C + q M_E(M*, z | S), q = 1 for samples selected by their halos (S not 1), else q = (M*/Mp)^50 / (1 + (M_t/M*)^4) with log10 M_t minimizing chi2 against the seven red-central halo masses of Mandelbaum et al. 2016 (M_p = M*, R_e = 0.5 x the SPARC size relation, z_eff, no selection, M200c -> M200m h^-1 with the Dutton and Maccio concentration); M_halo = (M_ref^8 + (1e8 Msun)^8)^(1/8); M_E = posterior mean of M200c on a grid in log10 M200c from 9.0 to 16.5 (step 0.005) with weight dn/dlnM (Tinker et al. 2008, colossus, H0 67.1, Om 0.3175, Ob 0.049, sigma8 0.8344, ns 0.9624) x exp(-0.5 [(log10 M* - log10 M*_Moster(M200c, z))/0.180]^2) x S(M200c) (Moster, Naab and White 2013 with redshift evolution; 0.180 = sqrt(0.15^2 + 0.10^2) dex); below M* = 10^9.5 Msun M_E is the mean inversion; NFW with dark mass (1-fb) M_halo inside r200 at the halo redshift, Dutton and Maccio (2014) concentration, satellites x (1 - 0.54 log10(D/r200,host)) (Moline et al. 2017); no contraction; fb = 0.049/0.3175, h = 0.671; lensing M_p as a point mass; KiDS lens stacks only: c x (4.67/5.26) (M200 h / 1e14 Msun)^(-0.01) (Neto et al. 2007, Millennium: median c of all haloes over relaxed haloes; about 0.93 at 1e12 Msun)

selection_S.CLASH clusters: M200c > 5e14 Msun (Postman et al. 2012: X-ray selected, kT > 5 keV)
selection_S.MaNGA BCGs: M200c > 1e14 Msun (the MaNGA BCG program's aim)
selection_S.every other sample (disks, dwarfs, early: none (chosen by their light, not their halos)

baryons: as T26: stellar g_bar of spheroids with a measured velocity dispersion x alpha_IMF = 10^(0.38 log10(sigma_e/200 km/s) - 0.06 + 0.215) (Posacki et al. 2015; Chabrier scale via Madau and Dickinson 2014), for the 50 MaNGA BCGs and the 16 SPARC early types
coefficient_count: 3 fitted to the benchmark (A, B, C on disks alone); M_t set on external lensing data (SDSS red centrals); the selection thresholds are the surveys' own

mandelbaum_red_calibration.note: a calibration now, not a check; the formula does not follow the red-central relation closely

held_out_strict.other_scores: identical to the main mask (nothing else depends on the mask now)

change_vs_T44_held_out.verdict: passes PROTOCOL_T45 on both masks; replaces T44

caveats: the KiDS early/late split falls from 0.071 to 0.051 dex (data 0.16 to 0.21): the external threshold is higher than the one the benchmark preferred
Mandelbaum et al. (2016) is no longer an unfitted check
the formula over-predicts the halos of blue SDSS centrals at 10^10.56 and 10^10.85 suns by 0.34 and 0.13 dex (unaffected by M_t), the same direction as the Milky Way
status: retrospective; frozen here for any later blind test
